lines.cap: Solve this puzzle, and someone recruits you. Twelve years later, nobody knows who.
lines.say: Solve this puzzle, and someone recruits you. Twelve years later, nobody knows who.

lines.cap: January 2012. An image appears on 4chan. White text on black. We are looking for highly intelligent individuals. Find the hidden message.
lines.say: January 2012. An image appears on 4chan. White text on black. We are looking for highly intelligent individuals. Find the hidden message.

lines.cap: Thousands tried. The clues used codes, old books, hidden data inside pictures, and even phone numbers.
lines.say: Thousands tried. The clues used codes, old books, hidden data inside pictures, and even phone numbers.

lines.cap: Then the hunt left the internet. Posters appeared on poles, in fourteen cities around the world, on the same day. Each with a QR code.
lines.say: Then the hunt left the internet. Posters appeared on poles, in fourteen cities around the world, on the same day. Each with a QR code.

lines.cap: The few who reached the end were invited to a secret forum. Then, silence.
lines.say: The few who reached the end were invited to a secret forum. Then, silence.

lines.cap: Who was it? A spy agency? A bank? Hackers? Nobody has ever proven it. They came back in 2013 and 2014. Then they vanished.
lines.say: Who was it? A spy agency? A bank? Hackers? Nobody has ever proven it. They came back in 2013 and 2014. Then they vanished.

lines.cap: It's the only job interview in history where you solve twenty puzzles, and never find out the company.
